comment: Example API key file. Copy to api-keys.json and replace the entries. Only a SHA-256 digest of each secret is stored, so this file never holds a usable credential on its own. Mint entries with: go run ./cmd/cgctl keygen --principal <id> --system-role admin

keys.comment: The digest below is a placeholder, not the hash of any real secret, so this file cannot authenticate anyone as written. Run cgctl keygen and paste its output here.
